subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “History is richer when it includes imperfect human marks.”?
options: It can begin when someone notices a small waste and says something.
A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.
A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.
A scratched sentence can prove that someone stood there, felt something, and wanted to leave a trace.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It can begin when someone notices a small waste and says something.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A public space becomes more alive when ordinary people are invited to add something of their own.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A list, checked carefully every day, can protect someone when they are too tired to protect themselves.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「History is richer when it includes imperfect human marks. A scratched sentence can prove that someone stood there, felt something, and wanted…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
